lines.text: [fade start=2 length=12]Tier-2 city. Early morning. Sunlight slants through a wooden window grill.[/fade]

lines.speaker: Maa
lines.text: [wave amp=14 freq=3 connected=1]Beta, uth jao! School ki bus aane wali hai.[/wave]
Maa hands you a steel tiffin box, still warm.

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.text: Aaj test hai na? [color=#f5b87d]Tayyari ho gayi?[/color]

choices.text: I want to invent something new today!

lines.text: [wave amp=8 freq=2 connected=1]The morning is warm. Pollen drifts through slanted sunlight.[/wave]
You walk to the bus stop, tiffin clutched tight.
Exam Hall. [shake rate=15 level=3 connected=1]Ceiling fan ticks overhead. Pencils scratch.[/shake]
[fade start=0 length=20]The lights cut out at 8:47 PM.[/fade]
You light the emergency lamp. [wave amp=6 freq=1.5 connected=1]Moths gather almost instantly.[/wave]

lines.speaker: Maa
lines.text: Beta, doodh leke aayi hoon. Thoda break le lo.
Papa is sitting on the floor with the household account book.
[shake rate=8 level=2 connected=1]Maa is folding clothes nearby, very quietly.[/shake]

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.text: [shake rate=12 level=3 connected=1]Is mahine thoda tight hai.[/shake] Naya school bag agle mahine.

choices.text: I understand. I'll study harder so I get a scholarship.
Papa, can we start a small shop like uncle?

lines.text: [fade start=0 length=30]Years pass in a blur of textbooks, tuition classes, and evenings on the balcony watching kites cut each other down.[/fade]
At 15, you crack the entrance exam.
[pulse color=#ffd28a freq=1.6]The family hugs you. Maa cries. Papa pretends he isn't.[/pulse]
